subject.title: improve(models): source pricing from hosted catalog

question: Should upgrading a configuration with `models.pricing.enabled: false` preserve a no-remote-pricing preference by disabling hosted catalog refresh, or should it intentionally allow hosted catalog traffic after clearly warning the operator?
rationale: The old setting controlled direct third-party pricing fetches, while the only proposed replacement disables the broader hosted metadata-and-pricing catalog; selecting the permanent compatibility behavior is a product and privacy/network-policy choice.

options.title: Preserve the explicit opt-out
options.body: Have Doctor migrate the explicit false setting to the chosen no-hosted-pricing state and add upgrade coverage for the resulting Gateway behavior.

options.title: Retire the preference deliberately
options.body: Keep deleting the setting, but make Doctor and upgrade documentation clearly warn that hosted catalog traffic may resume and require an operator choice.

recommendation.title: Preserve the explicit opt-out
recommendation.body: Have Doctor migrate the explicit false setting to the chosen no-hosted-pricing state and add upgrade coverage for the resulting Gateway behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author owns the proposed migration and pricing-resolution design in the available history.
